Avec le mode Finance (activé par défaut):
With Finance mode (on by default), you can borrow (7 % per year, within a capacity that grows with your producing wells; the remaining debt counts against your net worth to win), store production,
        hedge a price and restart a well through enhanced oil recovery (EOR).
\n Des accidents sont possibles ::
Accidents are possible: blowout, strike, environmental incident. The game then stops and a
        window explains the consequences, you resume whenever you like. Practice mode switches finance off: only
        the choice of your two best targets counts.

Roche propre et poreuse : GR bas à modér: Clean, porous rock: low to moderate GR, density below 2.65 as soon as it is porous, no strong density-neutron separation in water. Tight sandstone (φ < 5 %) has the same curves but no porosity: it is neutral.
Galets cimentés, même réponse qu'un grès: Cemented pebbles, same response as a sandstone (sandstone class in the game) with often more irregular porosity. Rare on a section.
GR très bas, densité de 2,71 en l'absenc: Very low GR, density of 2.71 with no porosity, fast sonic (47 µs/ft). Oolitic, reefal and fractured limestones are the reservoirs; clayey or marly limestone is neutral.
Calcaire micritique blanc très fin : mêm: Very fine white micritic limestone: same curves as limestone. Very porous but very poorly permeable in practice.
Reconnaissable à sa densité forte (2,87: Recognisable by its high density (2.87 g/cc pure) and its very fast sonic (43 µs/ft). Vuggy porosity possible.
GR élevé (autour de 115 API), résistivit: High GR (around 115 API), low and flat resistivity (1 to 3 Ω·m), intermediate density and neutron. A tight clay with 60 to 95 % clay content seals a reservoir.
